content: We're starting to get quite the backlog of fuzz failures in oss-fuzz and while I've historically been the one to address things I've been pretty busy recently and won't have a chance to look at these failures for a bit. Would someone else be willing to volunteer to help fix these failures? So far I'm not seeing anything that's like CVE-worthy it's moreso that the fuzzers are all going to be tripping over these preexisting failures and will be unable to make any progress unless we fix these
The second two are the issue where we consume fuel on a bulk operation even if it is OOB. Made a new issue for it.
